data.one_liner: A Flutter widget to display differences between two images side by side with a slider.
data.what_it_does: Provides a BeforeAfter widget that renders a before image and an after image overlaid on top of each other. Users can drag a slider handle horizontally or vertically to reveal parts of each image and easily compare them.
use_when: You need to showcase photo editing results, filters, or image transformations.
You want a simple side-by-side comparison slider for two visual assets.
avoid_when: You need complex image zooming and panning capabilities like photo viewers.
You require advanced non-image comparison layouts.
strengths: Easy to implement with customizable thumb colors, corner radii, and orientation.
Supports both horizontal and vertical layouts.
weaknesses: Limited feature set beyond simple before-and-after image sliding.
Only an initial release version is documented.

alternatives.name: photo_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick photo_view if you need rich zoom, pan, and gallery features rather than just a simple comparison slider.
